content: This closes the loop on a pattern from the last three cycles: real execution (an actual upload attempt) kept surfacing failures that pure authoring/reading missed, and each was fixed as a one-off. This skill converts that accumulated tacit knowledge into something a future session reads before it repeats the same trial-and-error. Deliberately kept at .claude/ (Claude Code project tooling) rather than as a plugins/ product, since it documents how to build this repo's plugins, not a capability the colony's own roles invoke during a PMCR-O cycle.

next_seed.summary: If a fourth distinct Cowork upload failure mode is ever found, add it to .claude/skills/create-plugin/SKILL.md in the same cycle as the fix, not as a separate follow-up — the skill only stays trustworthy if it's updated at the same time the bug is fixed.
